title: A Tunnel - North Delta Diversion Schedule
source: COEQWAL CalSim3 run s0065 (Delta Conveyance Project, DWR 2025 climate adaptation version), north-Delta diversion boundary series as delivered for the RMA runs in October 2026. Monthly means of the daily boundary series, which is a rational-histospline interpolation of CalSim monthly volumes, rounded to the nearest 10 cfs.
comparison: Water diverted at the north Delta intakes into the tunnel. CalSim Baseline (s0020) has no tunnel, so every value is also the difference from CalSim Baseline.
notes: monthlyDiversionCfs lists one value per calendar month of the period, in order.
August 2019 averages about 25 cfs, below offThresholdCfs, so it counts as off.

Diversions follow the Delta Conveyance Project bypass flow rules (DCP Operations Plan, August 2024, Table 3.1-1 and Sub Table A), which depend on month and on Sacramento River flow, mainly at Wilkins Slough.
Salinity data ends 2020-11-29, so charts clip the last period to that date.
